This barley plot is small, only about a quarter of a timad, so I do not spend too much cash on it. I grow barley mostly for our injera and for the household — the bigger plots I use for wheat and other things. I will put some DAP at planting like I did last year, maybe half a bag since this plot is small, and a little urea when the barley is knee-high. I keep my own seed from last harvest — the improved barley seed is not always at the cooperative and I trust what I saved. We have oxen and cattle so I spread some manure before ploughing. No spray, no irrigation — the meher rains are what we depend on.
